matching.discovery: Only metrics emitted by a re-executed supported operation enter the matrix for a given scenario. A listed metric may be absent in an operation group if its result does not produce that field.
matching.identity: Semantic identity and unit determine whether two values describe the same measure. A shared display key is insufficient. The scenarios must be from the active module.
matching.currency: Money requires matching ISO currency. Dimensionless metrics require currency where explicitly listed. Core replay performs no currency conversion.
matching.required_context: For a compatible pair, every stated context field must exist on both sides and be equal, except bases transformed by an approved normalization.
matching.context_notes: Different numerical inputs and disclosed assumptions are allowed when the semantic basis remains comparable. A delta measures the stated scenario outcomes. It is not an overall offer ranking.

classifications.direct: Same semantic identity, unit, currency where required and required financial context; report differences from the best available value.
classifications.normalized: Known discrete-compounding rate conventions converted exactly to a common annual effective rate through available exact originating quotes.
classifications.contextual: A required context field or one operand is missing or differs, or normalization is unavailable. Inspect the original values side by side without a delta.
classifications.incompatible: The economic meaning, unit or required currency differs. No delta is computed.
classifications.undefined: A present result has no defined mathematical value, such as a zero denominator, unmet payback or legally undetermined amount. Null is never treated as zero.

precision.canonical: Use engine-produced exact rationals or the engine's higher-precision approximate value when a method is numeric. Raw rational collection bounds each component to 16384 bits.
precision.statutory_quantized: An exact value after required settlement rounding, such as BR-2026.1 tax. The underlying unrounded theoretical tax is not substituted.
precision.presentation_rounded: When canonical data cannot be used and a numeric presentation is available, the decimal shown is the comparison input and its known display precision applies.
precision.rate_delta: Absolute difference is in fractional units. Percentage-points difference multiplies the fractional delta by 100. Relative percent is independent of percentage points.
precision.reference_zero: Relative difference and percent are undefined at zero baseline.
precision.reference_negative: Relative difference uses alternative minus reference divided by the absolute reference.

approved_normalization.common_basis: effective annual rate under discrete compounding
approved_normalization.limit: Known positive integral frequencies within the engine bound. Reuse the exact original quote or exact annual anchor. No annualization of irregular cash flows, unknown periods, MIRR or uncertified display approximations.

omitted.reason: A root set may contain none, one or multiple candidates. Implicit root selection could change the meaning of the scenario.

financial.time_context: Dated cash flows carry origin, terminal date and actual day-count convention. Periodic NPV and payback use abstract model periods. An inferred rate and periodic MIRR carry unknown frequency and cannot be annualized.

investment.return_semantics: All three simple return variants are accumulated. Gross and net, and nominal and real, use distinct definitions and bases. None is treated as an annualized or time-weighted return.
investment.horizon: Same frequency, elapsed horizon, origin and actual terminal date are required for performance and ending-amount deltas. Varying horizons may be inspected side by side.
investment.assumptions: Product, rate basis, reinvestment, flow timing, costs, inflation and user tax assumptions are retained as replay context. Product and modeled growth assumptions can differ without implying an overall ranking.

loans.total_cost: Undiscounted total paid minus principal. Nominal cost deltas require matching comparable financing and repayment basis. Rates, fees, grace and extra policy remain assumptions that can be inspected.
loans.effective_cost: Common annual effective economic estimate against dated installments under ACT/365 Fixed, based on net disbursement and projected payments. It is not regulatory CET.

separate_operation.minimum: Identical financed principal, contractual period count, disbursement, full payment-date sequence and ledger rounding scope. Distinct repayment methods can meet those requirements.
separate_operation.mismatch: Separate proposal summaries remain visible, the minima array is empty and nominal_cost_comparison is loan_nominal_basis_mismatch.

tax.baseline: BR-2026.1 only. Unsupported dates and jurisdictions fail on original scenario validation rather than falling through to comparison.
tax.time_context: Monthly rules use the event calendar month, annual models the event calendar year, and holding/redemption and ICMS rules the specific taxable event date.
tax.basis: Jurisdiction, rule version, regime and relevant tax period are required. Product categories are additionally required for the fixed-income amounts and rates. Statutory nominal and actually payable IBS/CBS are distinct.

business.ratios: Markup uses unit cost, pricing margin uses unit price, statement margins use revenue and profitability ratios use their own stated denominators.
business.unknown_period: Statement amounts and performance ratios that require accounting period, valuation date or investment horizon remain contextual when those fields cannot be established by the model.
business.cycle: Calendar-day measures require the same measurement-period day count. Division by zero remains undefined.
business.plan: Profit is accrual. Cash flow is nominal. NPV is discounted cash flow from period zero. Plan totals require the same abstract horizon.
